from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u096/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f3b202ab.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = 5 if any(5 in row for row in grid) else 6
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        if len(cols) >= 2:
            for c in range(min(cols), max(cols) + 1):
                if grid[r][c] != marker:
                    out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        if len(rows) >= 2:
            for r in range(min(rows), max(rows) + 1):
                if grid[r][c] != marker:
                    out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
